mapper.select: SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_parent_id AS parent_id, sys10_tdm_check_form_type AS tdm_check_form_type, f_cdnm('TdmCheckFormType', sys10_tdm_check_form_type, sys10_parent_id, f_today()) AS tdm_check_form_type_name, sys10_file_nm AS file_name, sys10_note AS note, TO_CHAR(sys10_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, sys10_file_ext AS file_ext FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{companyId} AND sys10_tdm_check_form_type LIKE #{formType} AND CONCAT(sys10_file_nm, sys10_note) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY sys10_tdm_check_form_type , sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , sys10_note COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , sys10_reg_date
